candidate_uv_output.board_documented_fet: onboard NMOS PWM output, up to 6 A/channel per filed SP803E user manual
candidate_uv_output.esp32_boot_strap_pin_status: GPIO25/26/27 are not ESP32 Series boot strapping pins
candidate_uv_output.selection_reason: Existing AUX backend maps GPIO25 to UV main; GPIO26 to UV short. This candidate adds no new pin choice.
qualification_required: read back exact installed WLED firmware and LED output topology without writing
confirm installed SP803E board revision matches FCC-filed model/manual
bench-confirm onboard NMOS PWM channels remain OFF during power-up/reset and WLED restart
verify each UV load voltage/current and its matching supply and switching path
verify no backfeed or overcurrent between UV rails and the SP803E/controller supply
verify fail-dark PWM output through power-up, reboot, Wi-Fi loss, and WLED restart
measure strip wavelength and irradiance; complete placement/exposure review
bench-check underglow coexistence and current/thermal limits

owner_override: existing owner control boundary has priority
integration: Use aux_uv_policy.py and existing WLED JSON/segment route after per-channel ratings and segment IDs are qualified. No new transport or firmware protocol.
fail_safe: OFF on disabled feature, hardware unavailable, missing configuration, or invalid setpoint
